description: Wireless CarPlay gate patches for the webOS Gen5W_L head unit (x86-64). Applied to the genuine /app binaries (firmware-derived; the binaries themselves are NOT in this repo). See docs/11-wireless-carplay-patches.md. Firmware-derived binaries stay gitignored; this manifest + apply_carplay_patches.py regenerate them from the owner's genuine files.

targets.name: iAP2Service-2.0
targets.purpose: Advertise the WirelessCarPlay transport (ComponentId 0x0100) in iAP2 IdentificationInformation. Repurposes the USB-device else-branch of createIdentificationInformationParamList (@0x207fa) -- fires when NOT in USB-host mode, i.e. the wireless case; the wired USB-host branch is untouched.
targets.anchor_note: Unique 72-byte signature in-file; the two edits are at relative byte 9 and 56 within it. file_offset == VA.
caveats: The WirelessCarPlay transport top-level PARAM ID (0x18) is the one value not resolvable statically (dead in firmware; public sources give 0x13 / 0x15 / 0x18). 0x18 is used; it collides with no param this firmware emits (0xa,0xf,0x10,0x12,0x14,0x15,0x16,0x22). If a test iPhone silently sends IdentificationRejected, change the byte at 0x20e1f to 0x13 or 0x15 and retry.
Advertising the transport is necessary but not sufficient -- see docs/11 for the non-patch items (AppProjection -wpp:1, Wi-Fi credential generator, 5 GHz SoftAP).

targets.name: BluetoothHMI
targets.purpose: Force BluetoothManagerQML::isSupportWPP() true so the BT bootstrap offers wireless CarPlay. Overwrites the entry of sub_4fe72 (the WPP 'is supported' core = (getWPP()!=0xffffffff)) with 'mov eax,1; ret' -- returns before any stack/canary setup.
targets.anchor_note: This prologue (sub rsp,0x18; mov rax,fs:0x28) is NOT unique in-file, so the edit is applied by file_offset 0x4fe72 (== VA), guarded by the whole-file stock_sha256. The apply script verifies the stock bytes at the offset before writing.

edits.meaning: first 6 bytes -> mov eax,1; ret (byte 7 (0x8b) unchanged, now dead code after ret)

delivery: Ship the patched binaries in the TOCTOU evil rootfs with SMACK64EXEC=Privileged set (chsmack -e Privileged, preserved in the tar xattrs) -- see docs/10-smack.md. End-to-end function is NOT verifiable without the car + an iPhone.
